subject: Medisurge post-sign handoff: activation runway, owners, and kickoff
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Handing off Medisurge — activation timeline & asks

Hi team,

Quick handoff note for Medisurge (signed SOW attached). High level: they committed to Redwood Dedicated with a 6-month reserved pool, primary use is realtime LLM inference for clinical summarization (non-PHI but high sensitivity). Deal owner: me (Aditya). 

Key facts:
- Go-live target: 2027-05-20 (customer requested)
- Staging kickoff ideally week of 2027-04-19
- Expected steady-state throughput: ~800 reqs/min, p95 latency target <= 300ms
- Data residency: US (customer asked for us-east-2 but OSS OK; see note below)
- Contract: SOW signed (attached), MSA signed earlier this quarter

Open/risks:
1) Customer requested a dedicated VPC peering option; engineering team will need network diagram and ACL rules.
2) They asked about SOC2 attestation for audit — Monica, can you confirm what we need to provide?
3) There is a procurement hold for custom SLA language on incident notification windows. Jason at procurement is the contact.

Asks for CS/Implementation:
- Please assign a CS owner and an implementation PM for the kickoff and runbook.
- Kickoff window suggestions: 2027-04-19 or 2027-04-20.
- Review attached SOW and the DocuSign transaction (link below) and confirm any redlines outstanding.

Attachments: Medisurge_SOW_signed.pdf
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/transaction/abc123-med-sow
HubSpot: HS-83429

Thanks — I can join the first kickoff if useful.

Best,
Aditya
Sr. Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Handing off Medisurge — activation timeline & asks

Thanks Aditya — welcome Medisurge team (looping Grace and implementation). I am happy to own CS for this account. A few clarifying Qs before we lock owners and dates:

1) Acceptance criteria: can you confirm the SOW acceptance tests (we need explicit pass/fail on summarization accuracy thresholds, latency SLO, and throughput targets)? I didn't see the exact metric thresholds in the SOW PDF.
2) MSA: you mentioned it was signed earlier — any pending redlines related to data retention or log access?
3) Point of contact at Medisurge for technical onboarding: is that Olivia (CC'd by Aditya)? If we need a separate engineering contact for VPN/VPC peering, please share.

Proposed owners and next steps:
- CS Lead: Marissa Cole (me)
- Implementation PM: Vivek Kulkarni (proposed)
- Success Engineer: I suggest assigning one of our low-latency engs to own perf tuning (I'll confirm once Vivek provides the staging IPs)

Kickoff: I can do 4/19 10am PT or 4/20 9am PT — Vivek, which works for you?

For our internal runbook, I'm linking the onboarding checklist (internal): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xExampleOnboardingChecklist

Marissa
Customer Success Lead
Redwood Inference

- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) or equivalent attestation
- Completed security questionnaire (I’ve attached a short version we use for early staging)
